backlog.plain_title: A posted invoice can still be changed through the old sync route
backlog.technical_title: Posted-invoice immutability not enforced on /api/store and /api/store/[key] write paths
backlog.business_impact: Invoice figures not defensible to auditors/KRA; insider alteration risk on the legacy path
backlog.root_cause: Store blob path only protects journals (append-only), anti-wipe, and invoice line empty-shell overwrites; no posted-status guard on invoice header/amount/date/customer/lines edits
backlog.resolution: Add server-side posted-invoice guard to every deed_invoices write path: reject header/line/total/tax/date/customer/payment-state changes to posted|paid invoices with 409; allow status transitions only via approved credit-note/reversal/cancel workflows; audit both rejected and successful correction attempts
backlog.effort: Backend: lib/finance-invoice.ts merge guard + store route wiring + [id] route parity + tests
backlog.human_decision: Business-owner sign-off on the approved correction workflow list
acceptance_criteria: PATCH/PUT via /api/store, /api/store/[key], and /api/invoices/[id] cannot change amounts/lines/dates/customer of a posted invoice; server returns 409 and stored invoice is byte-identical
Rejected attempt writes an immutable server-side audit event with server-session actor
Credit note / reversal / cancellation workflows still function (regression tests)
amountPaid updates via the payments endpoint still work
tests: integration: store write of tampered posted invoice -> 409
regression: payments, credit notes, cancel flow
backlog.deployment_notes: No migration; deploy via standard script; monitor 409 rates for false positives
backlog.verification_status: Confirmed (code inspection 2026-08-05: no posted guard in app/api/store/route.ts; only preserveInvoiceLinesOnStoreWrite empty-shell protection)

backlog.plain_title: Anyone can try to guess the server's root password forever
backlog.technical_title: SSH permits root password login; no brute-force protection; root credential compromised (shared in plaintext)
backlog.business_impact: Entire host (data, secrets, backups) one credential from compromise
backlog.root_cause: Default cloud-init sshd config never hardened
backlog.resolution: Rotate root password; create non-root sudo user with SSH keys; verify key login; PermitRootLogin no; PasswordAuthentication no; install fail2ban; keep Contabo VNC console as recovery; remove stale ufw 3001 rule in same window
backlog.effort: Infra-only; sequenced checklist with live session kept open
backlog.risk: High if mis-sequenced (lockout) — human on hosting console required for final switch
backlog.human_decision: Maintenance window; who holds the new key/credentials
acceptance_criteria: Old root password no longer valid
Key-based login as service admin user verified from a fresh session BEFORE password auth disabled
sshd_config: PermitRootLogin no, PasswordAuthentication no (incl. cloud-init drop-ins)
fail2ban active with sshd jail
Documented console recovery procedure
tests: fail2ban ban simulation from throwaway IP
backlog.deployment_notes: No app downtime; keep two SSH sessions open throughout
backlog.rollback_notes: Contabo web console access; sshd config backup at /etc/ssh/sshd_config.bak-<date>
backlog.verification_status: Confirmed (Addendum evidence; unchanged since)

backlog.plain_title: All backups live on the same server, with passwords inside them
backlog.technical_title: Host-local-only backups; plaintext .env and hardcoded DB password in backup artifacts/script
backlog.business_impact: Single host loss destroys primary data and every backup; backup theft = full secret compromise
backlog.root_cause: Backup script written for local convenience; no offsite step ever added
backlog.resolution: Keep local schedule; add age/GPG-encrypted rclone/S3 offsite copy post-run; exclude .env (or encrypt separately); move DB creds to .pgpass root-only; add success/failure alerting (healthchecks.io or cron mail); perform and document restore drill to staging
backlog.human_decision: Offsite destination/provider and encryption key custody
acceptance_criteria: Every scheduled backup produces an encrypted offsite copy; verified checksum
No plaintext .env or hardcoded password in artifacts or script
Failure alert fires when a run is broken (tested)
Restore drill from offsite copy into deed_erp_staging documented and passing
backlog.verification_status: Confirmed (Addendum evidence; unchanged since)

backlog.plain_title: A silent logout can throw away a half-finished form
backlog.technical_title: 12h session with no refresh, no expiry warning, no draft autosave, no return-to-route; plus SEC-004 logout data purge
backlog.business_impact: Staff lose multi-minute repair intakes/quotations; double or missing entries
backlog.root_cause: SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=43200 fixed; middleware redirects to /login without returnTo; no draft layer
backlog.resolution: Sliding session refresh (server re-issues cookie on activity within threshold); pre-expiry warning modal with Extend; middleware preserves returnTo and login redirects back; draft autosave (localStorage, per-user-namespaced, excludes secrets) for repair intake, quotation, journal entry; restore prompt after re-auth; purge business drafts+deed_* on logout (closes SEC-004)
backlog.effort: Auth/session server change + AppShell warning + form draft hook + tests
backlog.risk: Medium (auth-adjacent; must not weaken session security)
backlog.human_decision: Session length and warning lead time
acceptance_criteria: Session expiry never silently destroys form work
User sees a warning before expiry and can extend without losing state
After re-login user returns to the original route
A recoverable draft is offered after re-auth; drafts never contain passwords/secrets
Logout clears business deed_* data and drafts (SEC-004)
tests: e2e: expiry during unsaved repair intake
unit: draft serializer excludes sensitive fields
backlog.rollback_notes: Feature-flag draft layer; session refresh revertable
backlog.verification_status: Confirmed (lib/auth/session.ts fixed TTL; no refresh/draft code found)
